intent_contract.persisted_encoding: RFC8785-JCS complete intent record plus one LF
intent_contract.marker_payload_rule: ASCII sha256:<SHA-256 hex of exact persisted intent.json bytes including LF> followed by one LF
intent_contract.output_scratch_name_grammar: exactly one engine-random 128-bit lowercase-hex token followed by exactly one purpose suffix: <32hex>.canonical, <32hex>.promotion-record, or <32hex>.lifecycle-transition
intent_contract.pending_path_identity_rule: Every writer, discovery, recovery, and finalization path is derived solely from the validated intent-bound transaction_id. promotion_id is a distinct promotion-record identity and is forbidden as a pending-directory key; the amendment positive intentionally uses unequal transaction_id and promotion_id values.

writer_state_model.intent_publication: Write, fsync, close, reopen, and verify the complete self-fingerprinted JCS+LF intent in the non-authoritative sibling .intent-staging directory before the pending directory exists; then create+fsync an empty pending directory and atomically rename the complete scratch file directly to intent.json. The pending namespace exposes only empty or complete intent, never intent.tmp or partial intent bytes.
writer_state_model.output_scratch_publication_rule: For each output in output_publication_order, create-new only its random purpose-typed scratch on the same filesystem; write/fsync/close; boundedly reopen no-follow and verify byte equality, document SHA-256, byte length, and the canonical fingerprint or closed record schema/ref/fingerprint/intent bindings; fsync .output-staging; atomically rename-no-replace to the exact pending stage; fsync pending, .output-staging, and transaction parent in that order; then boundedly reopen no-follow and reverify the exact pending stage. Destination collision or any verification/path/type mismatch refuses without replacement.
writer_state_model.output_scratch_crash_rule: A crash at S0 occurs after the engine retained complete expected bytes and bindings but before scratch creation; no scratch exists and the named pending stage remains absent. A crash at S1-S6 may orphan any zero-through-complete scratch prefix while the named pending stage remains absent. A crash at S7-S11 exposes the pending stage only as absent or exact complete bytes. Scratch is never a recovery axis or authority input and optional garbage collection is separately authorized.
writer_state_model.output_scratch_fault_enumeration: For each of the three purpose suffixes, inject after S0, after S1, after every zero-through-complete S2 scratch prefix in bounded fixtures, and after every S3-S11 boundary. The required Cartesian product contains every label in {S0,...,S11} exactly once per purpose in addition to the bounded S2 prefix fixtures; a missing or duplicate purpose/boundary pair fails conformance. Assert that pre-rename faults leave the pending stage absent, post-rename observations are absent or exact, scratch substitution never changes recovery selection, and retry/recovery never scans or deletes scratch.

output_scratch_vectors.complete_binding_source: outputs.new_canonical_fingerprint + outputs.new_canonical_document_sha256 + outputs.new_canonical_byte_length + retained exact canonical bytes
output_scratch_vectors.pre_rename_faults_S0_S6: at S0 no scratch exists; at S1-S6 scratch may be any 0..complete prefix and is ignored; pending stage is absent throughout
output_scratch_vectors.post_rename_faults_S7_S11: pending stage absent or exact complete; partial pending stage impossible
output_scratch_vectors.positive_terminal: S11 exact bounded no-follow reverify passed

output_scratch_vectors.complete_binding_source: outputs.promotion_record ref + semantic fingerprint + document SHA-256 + byte length + retained exact record bytes
output_scratch_vectors.pre_rename_faults_S0_S6: at S0 no scratch exists; at S1-S6 scratch may be any 0..complete prefix and is ignored; pending stage is absent throughout
output_scratch_vectors.post_rename_faults_S7_S11: pending stage absent or exact complete; partial pending stage impossible
output_scratch_vectors.positive_terminal: S11 exact bounded no-follow schema/ref/fingerprint/document reverify passed

output_scratch_vectors.complete_binding_source: outputs.lifecycle_transition ref + semantic fingerprint + document SHA-256 + byte length + retained exact record bytes including audit-only transitioned_at_utc
output_scratch_vectors.pre_rename_faults_S0_S6: at S0 no scratch exists; at S1-S6 scratch may be any 0..complete prefix and is ignored; pending stage is absent throughout
output_scratch_vectors.post_rename_faults_S7_S11: pending stage absent or exact complete; partial pending stage impossible
output_scratch_vectors.positive_terminal: S11 exact bounded no-follow schema/ref/fingerprint/document reverify passed

writer_state_model.marker_publication: For marker M, only M.tmp may contain an exact prefix before M exists; write+fsync the 72-byte payload, rename-no-replace M.tmp to M, then fsync the directory. M present requires M.tmp absent. Later markers require every earlier marker.
writer_state_model.pending_stage_state_rule: canonical.old alone may be absent, an exact prefix, or exact because amendment retains the authentic old target for completion; create forbids it. canonical.new, promotion-record.new, and lifecycle-transition.new are each independently absent or exact complete. Any partial pending new-output stage is mismatch even when it is an exact prefix; excess, substituted, wrong-type, symlink, or unsafe path is also mismatch.
writer_state_model.amendment_rollback_snapshot_completion: With exact old target retained under locks, absent canonical.old is create-new copied from target; an exact-prefix canonical.old is completed only by appending the missing target suffix; recovery fsyncs and reverifies exact fingerprint, document SHA-256, and byte length before publishing rolled-back. A crash leaves another exact prefix and retries. Create forbids canonical.old.
writer_state_model.rollback_cleanup_boundary_rule: From each exact W3-W9 rollback origin with target old/absent, first complete and fsync canonical.old for amend, then process rollback_cleanup_order_exact left-to-right. prepared.tmp may be an exact marker prefix and prepared must be exact. Each present new-output stage must be exact complete intent-bound bytes under no-follow revalidation before unlink; a partial stage is preserved mismatch. Fsync the pending directory after every unlink; absence is an idempotent no-op. Only names in this list may be removed. A crash exposes exactly a member of the union generated by every origin and every cleanup-list prefix.
writer_state_model.rollback_marker_continuation: Only after cleanup reaches the exact create/amend rollback base may rolled-back.tmp be create-new. Every zero-through-72-byte exact prefix is writer-reachable; recovery appends only the missing suffix, fsyncs and reverifies, rename-no-replace publishes rolled-back, and fsyncs the pending directory. Published rolled-back requires its tmp, every forward marker, and every staged file absent.
writer_state_model.pending_commit_finalization: With matching committed published under .pending, exact finals, no staged output, and the intended lifecycle successor committed, recovery first repeats the pending-directory fsync because the post-marker-rename fsync is not observable, then exact-revalidates the complete pending terminal payload; only then rename-no-replace <id>.pending to <id>.committed, fsync the transaction parent, and reverify the exact terminal set. Any exact, mismatching, unsafe, or otherwise pre-existing destination, simultaneous suffix, or byte/name mismatch preserves the complete pending journal and refuses without mutation. Every exact .committed observation repeats the parent fsync before returning because prior parent-fsync completion is not observable.
writer_state_model.pending_rollback_finalization: An exact .pending rollback terminal payload is writer-reachable after rolled-back publication. Recovery first repeats the pending-directory fsync because the post-marker-rename fsync is not observable, then exact-revalidates the complete rollback terminal payload; only then may an absent destination permit rename-no-replace to .rolled-back, transaction-parent fsync, and exact terminal-set reverify. Every exact-pre-existing, mismatching, unsafe, or simultaneous-suffix .rolled-back destination preserves the complete pending evidence and refuses without replacement or cleanup. Every exact .rolled-back terminal observation repeats the parent fsync before returning because prior parent-fsync completion is not observable.
writer_state_model.terminal_marker_pending_fsync_replay_fau: For each terminal marker in {committed, rolled-back}, inject after marker rename but before the writer's pending-directory fsync, after the writer's pending-directory fsync, after recovery's mandatory repeated pending-directory fsync, and after exact terminal-payload revalidation. Recovery must repeat the pending-directory fsync before terminal directory rename in every published-marker observation and converge to the exact immutable .committed or .rolled-back terminal set.
writer_state_model.rollback_fault_enumeration: Inject after every R0-R9 reverify, unlink, directory fsync, marker create/write/fsync/rename, the mandatory repeated pending-directory fsync and terminal-payload revalidation after published rolled-back, terminal directory rename, and parent fsync. The symmetric committed path injects at the same terminal-marker replay boundaries. Repeated recovery must select exactly one predicate and reach the exact immutable terminal set; every partial pending new-output stage and every state outside the constructed writer/recovery closure selects preserved mismatch. Scratch contents never change the selected predicate.
writer_state_model.terminal_destination_cross_product_rule: Cross each published terminal marker under .pending independently with all four states of its corresponding destination axis. Only {committed_marker: published, committed_destination: absent} and {rolled_back_marker: published, rolled_back_destination: absent} may perform terminal rename-no-replace. Every exact-pre-existing, mismatching, unsafe, or simultaneous-suffix destination preserves the complete pending journal and refuses without replacement or cleanup.
writer_state_model.recovery_suffix_partition: No-directory, .pending, .committed, and .rolled-back predicates are disjoint. Only .pending may clean up, roll back, roll forward, or finalize a just-published marker. Every published committed or rolled-back marker under .pending first repeats the pending-directory fsync and exact terminal-payload revalidation before terminal directory rename. Exact terminal suffixes receive content-read-only verification and repeat the transaction-parent fsync. Every simultaneous, crossed, or other suffix/name state is mismatch and is preserved.
writer_state_model.scratch_axis_rule: .intent-staging and .output-staging are deliberately excluded from state_axes_exact; no scratch name, byte, type, count, or collision can select or alter a journal recovery predicate

cross_record_bindings: promotion_id equals outputs.promotion_record record_ref basename ID and record_fingerprint-derived ID
candidate_lineage candidate ref/fingerprint equals final candidate 1.3 whose fingerprint includes the complete exact-result binding
candidate_lineage validation-result ref/fingerprint equals candidate 1.3 validation_result_binding and the loaded result exact JCS+LF SHA-256/length equal that candidate binding
candidate, intake, normalized-content, validation-result, profile, definition, lifecycle, observation, coverage, approval, registry, and target bindings equal the retained promotion-time observations
outputs record_fingerprint equals each loaded record identity while document_sha256 and byte_length equal its exact persisted bytes

lifecycle-transition bytes bind the selected_contract prior head/state, promotion_id, validation result, and intended resulting head/state; after commit that transition is the successor rather than requiring the prior head to remain current
amend target basis, observed current, recovery old fingerprint, old document SHA-256, and retained canonical.old bytes are exact-equal
intent fingerprint recomputes from every top-level field except intent_fingerprint; marker payload hashes the complete persisted intent.json JCS plus LF
negative_vectors: writer, discovery, recovery, or finalization derives the pending directory from promotion_id or any value other than the validated intent-bound transaction_id; the negative remains required when transaction_id and promotion_id differ
intent_fingerprint included in its own preimage
pending directory contains intent.tmp or a partial intent.json rather than only empty or one atomically published complete self-verifying intent.json
create with any non-null old/current/basis binding or amendment with any null old/current/basis binding
definition, observation, coverage, or approval set missing, duplicate, reordered, incomplete, or excess
record ref basename, semantic fingerprint, raw document SHA-256, or byte length mismatch
marker gap, marker optimism, marker payload mismatch, final marker with matching tmp, or unknown pending-directory name
canonical.old is outside its allowed absent/exact-prefix/exact amendment snapshot grammar, or a create contains canonical.old
canonical.new, promotion-record.new, or lifecycle-transition.new is present but not exact complete intent-bound bytes; every partial pending stage is mismatch even when it is a correct prefix

output scratch is treated as journal authority, scanned or deleted by recovery, placed on another filesystem, published without exact verification, renamed with replacement, or followed by a missing/out-of-order pending/scratch/transaction-parent fsync or stage reverify
rollback cleanup state is not generated by an admitted W3-W9 origin and a prefix of the exact cleanup order, or cleanup would remove a name outside that list
rolled-back.tmp appears before the exact rollback base, is not an exact 0..72-byte marker prefix, or coexists with rolled-back
published rolled-back coexists with any forward marker/stage, has a mismatching payload, or appears under a suffix other than exact pending/rolled-back finalization
published committed pending payload encounters an exact-pre-existing, mismatching, or unsafe .committed destination, simultaneous pending/terminal suffix, or terminal byte/name mismatch
published rolled-back pending payload encounters an exact-pre-existing, mismatching, or unsafe .rolled-back destination, simultaneous pending/terminal suffix, or terminal byte/name mismatch
canonical target is neither exact old/absent nor exact new, or currentness cannot be revalidated

candidate_1_3_transitive_binding_contrac.rule: Intent 1.2 directly binds final candidate 1.3 and semantic result identity. Because final candidate identity includes the complete exact-result binding, intent transitively binds exact JCS+LF digest and length without adding an intent field.
candidate_1_3_transitive_binding_contrac.fresh_authority_rule: Every candidate-dependent selected authority is concrete and differs from historical_candidate_1_2_amendment_positive; no approval, promotion, lifecycle output, transaction ID, or pending directory is carried forward.
